validation_scope: SG-4A analytical conformance of the four-state Calcein/PI rule, its refusal reasons, its control calibration arithmetic and its versioned denominators to the frozen specification. Not a biological validation (SG-4B).

source.record_storage: This record is stored in a commit made after validated_source_commit. The storing commit is deliberately not named inside the record (a commit cannot contain its own hash); find it with `git log --format=%H -1 -- <manifest path>`. validated_source_commit identifies the source under validation, never the commit that stores this record.

files.rationale: calibrate() and classify(): control medians, separation SNR, refusal reasons, gates and states.
_describe(): classifiable and indeterminate denominators and the fraction-definition id.
Default gates, replicate floor and separation threshold, and the low<high validation.

SG-4A.criterion: every known-rule case equals the specification oracle; every required state and refusal reason is exercised

spec_conventions.both_markers_low: c < low_gate and p < low_gate (strict); equality to the low gate is not 'low' for this refusal, while viable_like/compromised_like accept equality (p <= low_gate, c <= low_gate)
spec_conventions.outside_control_range: flag appended when a finite scaled value is < 0 or > 1; classification uses the unclipped value, which is equivalent because both gates lie in [0, 1]

SG-4A.claim_boundary: analytical rule conformance only; biological validity is SG-4B
